text:
𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗔 𝗚𝗢 𝟮-𝟬 𝗨𝗣! 🇮🇳

Chasing 181 vs NZ, Tilak Varma's 51* off 26 and an unbroken 69-run stand with Nitish Reddy win it with 1 ball to spare 🔥

Santner's 4/21 wasn't enough for NZ 🏏

#Cricket #TeamIndia

facebook.caption:
𝗜𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗮 𝗻𝗲 𝘀𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗲𝘀 𝗺𝗲𝗶𝗻 𝟮-𝟬 𝗸𝗶 𝗯𝗮𝗮𝗱𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗲 𝗹𝗶! 🇮🇳🔥

New Zealand ke khilaaf 2nd T20I — 4 wickets se jeet, sirf 1 ball baaki! 🏏

👉 NZ ne banaye 180/5
👉 Tilak Varma – 26 balls mein 51* 💥
👉 Tilak aur Nitish Reddy ki 69 runs ki naabad partnership
👉 Santner ke 4/21 ke baad bhi India ne match nikaala 💪

Aaj ka hero kaun — Tilak ya Nitish? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #TeamIndia #INDvNZ
